warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.50 + 3.50 (7.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 2.50 + 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.50 (11.00). Origin A1 (A at the top of the sheet). The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04 and A-03. Vector CAD PDF; dimension figures are vector text, read off the rendered pages.

1''''' (1.80) is the S-02 / A-03 sub-chain 1.80 + 1.70 in bay 1-2 — the line of beam B1 between slab S1 and slab GS. It is the 5th dummy in the 1-2 gap because the truss panel ticks (T2 at 0.875 / 1.75, T3 at 1.167) come earlier; dummy names follow position order (section 4).

1'''' (1.75, Truss T2 panel point) and 1''''' (1.80, beam B1 line) are 0.05 apart — kept both: they are different points printed on different sheets (S-05 truss T2 panel chain vs S-02 structure plan).

Truss panel chains (S-05) carry no grid bubbles; they were anchored by their own support labels and sub-totals: T1 = 3.00 | 3.00 | 2.50 (8.50) with T3 drawn at the left post and T2 at the 6.00 post, i.e. D-C-B-A; T2 and T3 = 3.50 | 3.50 (7.00) between three T1 posts, i.e. grids 1-2-3 along rows B and D (S-03 plan). Every panel tick became a line per section 4 rule 4. Inner ticks are positioned off the lower-numbered / upper line; 0.833 x 3 = 2.499 and 1.167 x 3 = 3.501 against the printed sub-totals 2.50 / 3.50 — a 0.001 rounding in the drawing, absorbed by the last segment of each group.

Roof overhangs: S-03 and S-04 print 1.00 beyond grids 1 and 3 (1', 3'), S-03 prints 1.00 above A (A') and a 1.00 + 1.50 split of D-E (D' = 9.50, the main-roof low edge); S-04 prints 1.00 below E (E' = 12.00, the verandah-roof edge).

Purlin positions (@1.50 m) are not dimensioned individually, so they made no lines. The front laundry-yard slab (GS outside row A, bay 1-2, ลานซักล้าง on A-03) and the step strips ST-01/ST-02 print no depth on any sheet — no line invented for their outer edges.

z: A-07 (section A) prints ระดับถนนภายใน ±0.00, ระดับพื้นห้อง +0.46, ระดับหลังคา +3.50 and ระดับหลังคา +4.71 (chain 0.46 + 3.04 + 1.21 = 4.71). S-03 / S-04 give the two wall-plate (อะเส) tops +3.60 and +3.39. A-05/A-06/A-08 repeat the same level column and were not swept separately.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-07, A-03 (floor plan) and the level column of A-07. Other architectural/MEP sheets (A-04..A-06, A-08..A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-06 / S-07 print only member-internal dimensions (footing 0.50 + 0.50, depth 1.00 to the footing top, 0.25 / 0.05 / 0.05 layers, section sizes, slab and step sizes) — they stay on their elements.
